entries.claim: nba2k17-ws.2ksports.com is a historical NBA 2K17 web-service hostname.
entries.notes: Supports hostname and PC replacement-service feasibility context; does not establish exact routes or every build.

entries.claim: Port 17217 was used by a historical public NBA 2K17 private-server implementation.
entries.notes: Establishes historical significance of the port, not the complete retail-client contract.

entries.claim: A 2023 NBA 2K17 PC replacement-service developer reported success using a locally trusted certificate path.
entries.notes: Does not prove absence of certificate pinning for every client build.

entries.claim: sanitized-fixtures/probe.66686d164ca1.sanitized.jsonl contains lab self-test traffic, not NBA 2K17 client traffic.
entries.notes: May validate instrument behavior only; must never promote TLS/HTTP values from this file to OBSERVED_2K17.

entries.claim: Granite exposes a 16-byte big-endian field-record framing with a zero terminator and data section for NBA 2K19.
entries.notes: This is not evidence that NBA 2K17 uses the same framing.
